rationale: Initial compact models with six hours of history. A regularized linear autoregression tests whether local linear dependence suffices; LSTM tests gated nonlinear memory; causal dilated CNN tests convolutional sequence modeling. Daily history will be investigated after validation results and training-period temporal analysis.

Test a full-day history (144 steps) while retaining widths, learning rates and epoch budgets. Extend CNN dilations only as needed to cover the larger history. Identical eligibility masks keep evaluation timestamps fixed.

Full-day history reduced validation RMSE to 153.13 (RidgeAR), 160.26 (LSTM), and 160.28 (CausalCNN). Test stronger regularization of correlated linear lags (alpha 10) and double neural widths (32 and 16), keeping history, learning rate and stopping budgets fixed, to assess whether limited capacity explains the remaining neural error.
